name: Shopify Orders to Monday.com Fulfillment Board

parameters.content:
## 1. Receive and verify
Shopify signs every webhook with your secret. A missing or wrong signature, or no secret set in n8n, gets a 401 and an alert. A good one gets a 200 straight away, so Shopify never times out and resends.

## 2. Prepare the order
Skips repeat deliveries (same webhook ID) and other topics. Maps the order to your columns and sets the VIP and rush flags.

## 3. Sync to the monday board
Finds the item by order number. A new order gets an item plus one subitem per line item. An update changes the same item and adds any missing lines. Older updates are skipped. Rate limits wait as long as monday asks.

## 4. Alert the team
VIP and rush orders post to Slack with a link to the item, once per flag.

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ (String($env.SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET ?? '').trim() ? 'Shopify webhook rejected: the X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256 header is missing or wrong' : 'Shopify webhook rejected: SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not set in n8n, so every webhook is refused') + ' (topic ' + (/^[a-z_]+\/[a-z_]+$/.test($json.headers['x-shopify-topic'] || '') ? $json.headers['x-shopify-topic'] : 'not given') + ', shop ' + (/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\.myshopify\.com$/.test($json.headers['x-shopify-shop-domain'] || '') ? $json.headers['x-shopify-shop-domain'] : 'not given') + ').' + (String($env.SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET ?? '').trim() ? ' If real orders land here, check SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.' : '') }}
